response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), a AS (SELECT AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS av FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.cnt * 1.0) AS avg_count, AVG(c.cnt - a.av) AS avg_excess FROM c, a WHERE c.cnt > a.av

assumptions.assumption: orders.recordvault is unique per order, so the inner join yields one row per risk/margin record. An order with two records counts twice, as the request says.
Each distinct ordertune value is one type. The average is taken over types that have at least one matched record. A NULL ordertune, if present, would count as its own group.
